Quest Giver: Sam "Dog Walker"'s Dog

Quest Description: Explain the Dog's Strange noises

Quest Reward: None

Return to: Sam "Dog Walker"

Repeatable: No

Followed By: Loud Noises C

Last Build Updated: 155

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Find out what is wrong with the stable boy's dog.

Offer:

WOOF WOOF WOOF! WOOF WOOF WOOF WOOF! WOOF WOOF WOOF! WOOF WOOF WOOF WOOF!

Turn-in:

That stupid dog. Maybe those Frost Melee Wasps took his squeak toy. It would not surprise me at all if they did. No Sir, not one bit. Ohhh, and let's not forget the awful stench they leave behind that just won't go away! If only I were more important like the King's Bishop's Knight's Stableboy's lance holder maybe then I would have enough clout to make those stinking monsters listen to me, but nooooooo, I am just a lowly dog walker who only has one contract for walking one lousy, loud dog.

Someday, I will be more important I tell you... someday!

Level range: 55–100
